jyutping: jat1 ngaan5 zau6 jing6 dak1 ceot1

english.note: Use this when the person or thing is immediately recognizable by sight.

examples.english: Wearing that red coat, you are unmistakable to me.
examples.traditional: 你着住嗰件紅色外套，我一眼就認得出。
